chapter_seo_title: Desolate Era Ch. 47: Ji Ning's Brutal Justice and the Cost of Revenge in the Wildlands
chapter_meta_description: Ji Ning delivers a harsh, slow justice to Chuncao's killer. But the true cost of revenge is revealed in the cold political machinations of the Riverside Tribe's chieftain.
og_title: Desolate Era Ch. 47: The Sun-Exposure Execution
og_description: Ji Ning watches as his enemy rots under the sun. A new lesson in the harsh justice of the Wildlands.
twitter_title: Desolate Era Ch. 47: Ji Ning's Reckoning
twitter_description: The hunt is over, but the real test of power has just begun. Ji Ning learns the cost of his first major revenge.
